scenarios.scenario: Starting a conversation through the Try It test app

steps.text: Priya the team member opens the Try It test app for book-buddy
steps.observed: The app rendered its own placeholder screen: "Open this app from the console — In the console, open the project's Deployments page and, under Try it out, choose Try agent on an agent. The console hands this app the project's sign-in and the agent's address; there is nothing to configure here." Reading the app's bundle (assets/index-*.js) confirmed the launch state comes only from a URL hash `#/agent?project=&component=&issuer=&client_id=&resource=&endpoint=&scopes=`, built by the console when an operator clicks Try agent. This validation run was given book-buddy's and library-service's endpoint URLs and the test user's issuer/resource/username/password (from issue #2's roles-gate comment), but no client_id and no console session — the platform did not hand this run a way to construct that hash or an equivalent token, so the launch could not be reached. This is a platform/environment gap, not an app defect: the same client_id block prevents scenarios 1-7 of this feature from being driven at the API layer too (see their Given/When steps).
